user_saw: Under Bun, a CLI diagnostic could print a bare “Error” and a stack trace while omitting the message that explained what failed.
summary: The fix preserves the error message in version-resolution and uncaught-error diagnostics when the stack omits it.
reasoning: The July CLI rewrite preserved the existing stack-first fallback, which worked with Node’s message-bearing stacks. The trigger commit documented Bun 1.4 as a CLI runtime and added a direct Bun invocation of `--version`, exposing the existing formatter to stacks that can omit the message depending on garbage-collection timing. The original formatter predates the available local history.
